paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kiddushin 22b concerning a halakhah; Hyman sees some indication there that he lived in Rav Ashi’s time.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Kiddushin 22b paragraph explicitly writes Rav Achai [bar Ada] of Acha. The bracketed digital patronym is not a fresh Maharshal collation. Hyman’s some indication chronology and Maharshal reading in the heading remain attributed and tentative, without an era, teacher, or authority admission or importation of the legal issue.
